contentHtml: Hair Loss is also known as baldness refers to loss of hair from head. In the head itself there is around 100000 to 150000 hairs.  Our treatment helps in stopping the hair fall and gradually the lost one will come back.  Normally in a week’s time falling will stops and in three months time it started growing.  Hair becomes darken and become strong and healthy.   This treatment includes head massage using special medicated ayurvedic oil, applying herbal paste in the headm internal medication etc… as per the medical condition of the patient. You have to continue the medicines for at least six months.
